_README: Rental blocklist. vast.ai OFFER ids churn every listing, so entries key on
the stable machine_id / host_id; ip is recorded as a fallback for boxes we
only ever saw by ssh address. tools/vast_pick.py filters search results
through this file, and tools/deploy_box.sh prints the entry to paste when
Two failure classes we have actually hit, neither visible in the listing:
gpu_capped - right GPU model, but SW Power Cap pins the clocks. Measured
166 TFLOPS bf16 vs 234 on a healthy 5090 (71%), and -lgc is denied
inside the container, so it cannot be fixed from our side.
cpu_bound  - GPU is fine but the host CPU path collapses under the env
step + python reward loop. Scratch training is CPU-bound, so this only
shows up on scratch runs: one 256-core host sustained ~300k steps/s
where healthy boxes do 560-780k. Fine for warm/update-bound work,
Add an entry the moment a box is judged bad, before destroying it - the
identifiers are gone from `vastai show instances` once it is destroyed.
